theorems.statement: ∀ (E₁ E₂ E₃ E₄ : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E₁] [NormedSpace ℝ E₁] [NormedAddCommGroup E₂] [NormedSpace ℝ E₂] [NormedAddCommGroup E₃] [NormedSpace ℝ E₃] [NormedAddCommGroup E₄] [NormedSpace ℝ E₄] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (B : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₃ →L[ℝ] E₄) (f : E₁ → E₂) (g : E₁ → E₃) (U : Set E₁), 0 < α → α ≤ 1 → IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ m f U → (∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m g U → (∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m g y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) U ∧ ∀ K : Set E₁, IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun x => B (f x) (g x)) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
